description: Renovate rules shared by every app built from the swhurl Kotlin template. Apps extend this file (github>samclement/swhurl-app-template-kotlin:renovate-preset), so a change here reaches all of them on Renovate's next run.

packageRules.description: Kotlin and its compiler plugins release together; update them in one PR.

Minor, patch and digest updates merge themselves once every check passes (compile, tests, image build, smoke test). Each merge deploys to staging; production changes only through a promote. Apps without tests set automerge to false in their renovate.json.
Major updates wait for a person.
